fn drain(controls: &mut [Consumer<Record>; 4], ticks: &mut core::iter::Repeat<()>) {
    for (lane, ()) in ticks.by_ref().enumerate() {
        let available = controls[lane].available_at_entry();
        for _ in 0..available {
            let Ok(record) = controls[lane].try_pop() else {
                break;
            };
            apply(record);
        }
    }
}
